verdict.rationale: The Trusted Agent Protocol lets a merchant cryptographically verify that a request comes from a legitimate agent, and the platform captures commerce signals for dispute resolution. Neither documents attributing orders to the originating agent, nor any merchant reporting or filtering of transactions by agent. Agent verification is an adjacent building block a merchant would have to log and aggregate themselves, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a merchant, orders are attributed to the originating agent and I can report on or filter transactions by agent
